name: Heiterwangsee
kurzbeschreibung: Heiterwanger See at 976 m altitude: idyllic mountain lake in the Ammergauer Alpen with a 300 m canal to Plansee, passenger boat cruises, and circular trail.
oeffnungszeiten: See und Uferwege 24/7 frei zugänglich; Schifffahrt Ende Mai bis Mitte Okt täglich
beschreibung:
Overview

The Heiterwanger See is a picturesque, fjord-like high mountain lake located at an altitude of 976 meters in the municipality of Heiterwang in the Tyrolean Außerfern. Nestled between the steep rock faces of the Ammergauer Alpen and the Heiterwand, the lake covers an area of 1.37 square kilometers and reaches depths of up to 61 meters. Together with the immediately adjacent Plansee, it forms the second largest water system in all of Tyrol. Both lakes are seamlessly connected for hikers, boats, and passenger vessels via an approximately 300-meter-long connecting canal that was artificially deepened back in 1908.

Nature, Cruises & Leisure

Heiterwanger See impresses with its crystal-clear, nutrient-poor mountain water offering visibility depths of up to 15 meters, making it a popular diving spot and fishing ground for lake trout and char. A highlight of the lake is the historic Heiterwanger See- und Planseeschifffahrt: since the 1920s, passenger vessels – including MS Margarethe and MS Wilhelm – have linked the landing piers around the twin lakes. The scheduled boats operate in a combined round-trip and hop-on/hop-off service between Hotel Fischer am See in Heiterwang, the center of the lake (Kanal/Seespitze), and Hotel Forelle at Plansee. For nature and hiking enthusiasts, an approximately six-kilometer, family-friendly circular hiking trail leads around Heiterwanger See (walking time approx. 1.5 to 2 hours). Those wishing to circumnavigate both lakes completely can embark on the roughly 20-kilometer dual lake hike. A natural lido, boat rentals for electric and rowing boats, and stand-up paddleboarding round out the summer experience.

Visit & Getting There

The lakeshore and circular hiking trail are freely accessible free of charge year-round. Passenger boat cruises operate seasonally from late May to mid-October daily according to timetable. Cruise fares (2025/2026 season): Grand round trip of both lakes (Heiterwanger See and Plansee) adults €22.00, children (up to 14 years) €13.00, family ticket from €49.00 (cash only on board); partial routes from €10.50. Arrival by car: via the B179 (Fernpassstraße) to the Heiterwang exit, follow signs to the lake to the large parking area at Hotel Fischer am See (parking fee applies). By public transport: take the Außerfernbahn (DB/ÖBB) to Heiterwang-Plansee station, from where it is an easy 20-minute walk along a level footpath directly to the lakeshore.

Tips

The lakeside path along the northern shore is wide and well surfaced, making it ideal for strollers and all-terrain wheelchairs; the southern shore runs along narrower forest trails. Combining a boat ride with a hike is especially popular: take the vessel from Fischer am See to Seespitze and hike leisurely back along the shore. The sun terrace of Hotel Fischer am See serves freshly caught trout with lake views.
